report_meta.gist: Fixed the expiring-token bug in the auth client and added a regression test; one follow-up open on refresh-race handling.
report_meta.title: Auth token refresh fix

blocks.summary: Diagnosed and fixed the auth client dropping refreshed tokens, with a regression test.
blocks.details: The client cached the first access token and never re-read it after refresh. Moved the read inside the request path (src/auth/client.rs:88-104) and added a regression test (tests/auth_refresh.rs:12). `cargo test -p auth` passes (42 tests).
blocks.agent_guidance: Start from tests/auth_refresh.rs to understand the expected refresh behavior before touching the client.
blocks.caveats: Only the single-threaded refresh path is covered; concurrent refresh is the open question below.

blocks.summary: Read the token inside the request path rather than caching it on the client.
blocks.details: User preferred correctness over the micro-optimization of caching; re-reading per request is cheap here.

blocks.summary: How should concurrent refreshes be coordinated?
blocks.details: Two in-flight requests can both trigger a refresh and race on the token store. Needs a single-flight or lock around refresh.
Next session: add a single-flight guard around the refresh call in src/auth/client.rs and a concurrency test. The fix and test from this session are the baseline.
blocks.agent_guidance: Reproduce the race first with a 2-thread test before adding the guard.
